observations.classification: independent bounded confirmation of ROOT-INITIAL04-CONTRACT-014; no new unique count
observations.trace: WeightedIndex<u64> rejects empty inputs, all-zero total and checked-add overflow before creating the distribution, and then obtains its selected index from cumulative partitioning. For a positive total, the concrete UniformInt<u64> constructor admits [0,total), calculates a threshold, and its constructed sample retries u64 widening products whose low word is below that threshold; the u64 distribution reads next_u64 and the widening product uses u128. Equal cumulative boundaries skip zero-weight entries; selection lies within the input index range on the shown sorted nonnegative construction.
observations.condition: This concerns the concrete constructed u64 path and conditional uniform-word arithmetic only; it is not a claim that a PRNG sequence is random, that a sample always consumes one word, or that every other width, float, custom Weight, sample_single, SIMD, serializer, or feature configuration is valid. Source documentation at uniform_int.rs:61–66 warns of possible bias for other paths; it cannot be generalized over the inspected constructed rejection loop. No macro, sample, example or test was run.
observations.future_repair_direction: Preserve native checked errors, deterministic stable candidate order, zero-weight exclusion, bounds and variable draw count if changing surrounding owner contracts; do not create a duplicate sampler.

observations.classification: bounded current nonfinding, supporting historical 774 contract
observations.trace: The first-party weighted_order copies input, samples a positive remaining entry, zeroes that entry and repeats exactly the original positive count. Given the concrete native source contract, positive selections do not recur and later nonnegative totals cannot exceed a valid initial total. Quest choice rejects no candidates before the sampler; quest order returns an empty vector for no eligible candidates, canonicalizes identities, filters impossible/nonpositive entries and propagates SamplingError.
observations.condition: No full application graph or observed generation run is proven; target package and feature conditions are as recorded. weighted_order repeatedly rebuilds distributions, but no user-controlled unbounded workload or application performance conclusion is established.

lens_perspectives.assessment: Stable candidate producer and checked u64 weights reach the native sampler; quest preserves typed error while names format it early.
NonZeroU64 and existing SamplingError own the actual bounds/error meanings; language profile and name aggregate require their own semantic admission.
Native u64 constructor rejects empty, zero total and overflow; public language profile can represent zero and reaches an expect only if an unvalidated caller passes it.
Constructed u64 sampling uses rejection and checked widening; first-party f32 span may overflow under finite opposite-sign extremes, already recorded.
Weight totals, profile normalization and relation of retained source group to selected index require whole-aggregate guarantees.
Canonical deterministic sampler owns integer selection; name domain should preserve its error cause rather than invent a parallel sampler.
No duplicate sampler authority asserted from bounded native and project adapters; direct constructor and real consumer each have distinct boundary roles.
Preserve canonical order, generator/stream identity, precise zero/error behavior and potentially multiple full-word draws, not a fixed-one-draw assumption.
SamplingError enumerates empty, zero and overflow; native error has distinct invalid/overflow outcomes, with concrete u64 invalid-weight case unreachable.
Native optional serde derives and macros are source only; neither active features nor derived decoder validation are established.
Nonzero bounded sampling differs from float intervals and retained normalized profiles; avoid merging them merely because all produce numbers.
Name error formatting erases a typed cause at internal API; native diagnostic strings and domain stream IDs have different roles.
Full-width zero sentinel and rejection threshold express a native algorithm; original indexes are structural, not arbitrary application tuning.
